pr_body:
Fixes issues for setting up bidirectional unicast audio streams. 

There may be additional issues not covered by this PR (likely caused by some bad merge conflict resolutions). Any additional issues will be fixed in future PRs, so that we can get back to have the samples working right now. 

fixes https://github.com/zephyrproject-rtos/zephyr/issues/46369
fixes https://github.com/zephyrproject-rtos/zephyr/issues/46346

issue_context.title: LE Audio: Fatal crash when sending Audio data
issue_context.body:
**Describe the bug**
The broadcast source and unicast client both fail fatally when attempting to send data on a audio stream. 

**To Reproduce**
Flash and run the broadcast source (as that fails standalone) sample. 

**Expected behavior**
The broadcast source to start sending audio data

**Impact**
Showstopper for LE Audio. The issue seems to persist in both samples (although not failing babblesim). 

**Logs and console output**
```
[00:00:00.591,674] <dbg> bt_iso: hci_le_big_complete: BIG[0] 0x200061e4 completed, status 0

[00:00:00.592,498] <dbg> bt_iso: bt_iso_chan_set_state_debug: chan 0x20006218 iso 0x20005be0 connecting -> connected
[00:00:00.592,559] <dbg> bt_audio_broadcast_source: broadcast_source_iso_connected: stream 0x20006218 ep 0x2000623c
[00:00:00.592,620] <dbg> bt_audio_broadcast_source: broadcast_source_set_ep_state: ep 0x2000623c id 0x00 qos-configured -> streaming
[00:00:00.595,306] <dbg> bt_iso: bt_iso_chan_send: chan 0x20006218 len 40
[00:00:00.595,703] <dbg> bt_iso: bt_iso_chan_send: chan 0x20006218 len 40

[00:00:00.603,179] <err> os: mem_manage_fault:   Instruction Access Violation
[00:00:00.603,271] <err> os: esf_dump: r0/a1:  0x00000000  r1/a2:  0x00000019  r2/a3:  0x00000000
[00:00:00.603,363] <err> os: esf_dump: r3/a4:  0xff4672b5 r12/ip:  0x00000000 r14/lr:  0x0000f9e3
[00:00:00.603,424] <err> os: esf_dump:  xpsr:  0xa1000000
[00:00:00.603,485] <err> os: esf_dump: Faulting instruction address (r15/pc): 0xff4672b4
[00:00:00.603,576] <err> os: z_fatal_error: >>> ZEPHYR FATAL ERROR 0: CPU exception on CPU 0
[00:00:00.603,637] <err> os: z_fatal_error: Current thread: 0x20005e68 (unknown)
[00:00:00.917,205] <err> os: k_sys_fatal_error_handler: Halting system

```

**Environment (please complete the following information):**
 - Commit SHA or Version used: c62ee3be4e4f9c268a009bced3b4d969d7ccbe46

**Additional context**
Basically the same application does not fail as a babblesim test (https://github.com/zephyrproject-rtos/zephyr/pull/46204)

The iso broadcast and central iso samples are also fully functioning, so it's likely either some parameter or misconfiguration in the LE Audio stack.
